instruction: After reading this research paper, I'd like to bookmark the personal webpages of the first two authors and the last two authors. Please add them to a browser bookmark folder called 'Liked Authors' under the 'Bookmarks bar'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-20)

metadata.explanation: Variation focuses on first 2 authors (Linxi Fan, Guanzhi Wang) and last 2 authors (Yuke Zhu, Anima Anandkumar). Expected URLs verified from paper metadata and typical academic webpage patterns. Uses existing bookmark evaluator with liked_authors_websites_urls type.

llm_judge_reasons: Metric logic does not verify that exactly 4 bookmarks are created (one per author)
The set comparison allows multiple bookmarks for the same author as long as the total set matches a valid combination
Expected URLs correctly identify the 4 authors from the paper with valid URL variants
Getter correctly extracts bookmark structure from Chrome bookmarks file
Metric correctly checks for 'Liked Authors' folder under bookmark_bar
Metric correctly handles multiple valid URL variants per author using product combinations
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify the metric to verify exactly 4 bookmarks exist in the 'Liked Authors' folder
Ensure each author has exactly one bookmark (not multiple URLs for the same author)
Add logic to verify len(liked_authors_urls) == 4 before checking combinations
Alternative: restructure expected to map each author to their URL variants, then verify one URL per author
